description: Single symbol, single window. Reader fetches last 24h of news + social, aggregator produces signal, digest-writer writes ./out/digest-BTCUSDT-<ts>.md.
Fan-out across BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB/ADA. Orchestration layer (the parent FastAPI service or a cron job) iterates and steers one session per symbol — same shape as earnings-reviewer's per-ticker fan-out.
Compute signal only. Orchestrator stops after the aggregator returns; digest-writer is not invoked. Useful when the trading-engine wants the raw signal without the markdown ceremony.
Constrain reader to tier-1 sources only (major outlets, exchange announcements). Useful for a weekly editorial digest where social noise would dominate.
